{{Top|leg}}
'''"Fanging"''' was an occupation available to the [[Sic-Six/Legends|Sic-Six]] arachnoid species. As the Sic-Six naturally produced a venom that caused a psychoactive effects in other sentient species, a Sic-Six '''"fanger"''' could inject poison to voluntary subjects in exchange for money.<ref name="g4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>

Certain "fangers" stole their customers's assets during these people's stupor.<ref name="g4" />

[[Trix-sor]] was a Sic-Six "fanger".<ref name="g2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref>
